answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that only unlocks after peers attest to real, useful work over time. Reputation forms like a pearl, layer by layer, never all at once: a sybil operator must fund each fake separately and keep it fed in a lagoon of locked collateral while honest agents share one lantern of public audit history that exposes copy-paste behavior. Cloning an identity is cheap; cloning a verified work history is not, so attacks scale in cost while honest participation stays cheap.
